code:
server.properties (topic-level, overridable):

log.retention.hours   = 168      # delete after 7 days
log.retention.bytes   = -1       # -1 = unlimited (off)
caption: Whichever limit is hit first triggers deletion.

code:
cleanup.policy = compact

Topic "user-profile-changelog" (key = user_id):

  user_id=42, {email: a@x.com}  -> deleted (superseded)
  user_id=99, {email: b@x.com}  -> kept
  user_id=42, {email: c@x.com}  -> kept (latest for 42)
caption: Keeps the latest value per key forever, not "longer retention."
